Preserve the precise character, horse coat/mane/tack, collar, helmet/hood, flask/tool, face and proportions from image1. Pony hoof baseline local y480; pony body and saddle center stay in the SAME place; rider head normally near local y50, full silhouette inside margins. Uniform zoom, no per-pose enlargement. This is HERO DEFEAT gesture group, NOT troop death: no blood, no falling body, no second person or dismount. The mounted commander reacts to losing and returns to a quiet seat. Draw eleven genuinely different coherent stages:
1 upright uneasy neutral, both shoulders level.
2 chin begins lowering, gaze down.
3 shoulders slump, pony lowers head slightly.
4 free hand lifts from reins toward chest.
5 free hand rises beside face.
6 palm rests at forehead, head bows.
7 deepest defeated seated slump, head down, elbow lowered.
8 free hand descends away from face.
9 torso begins straightening, hand near reins.
10 head lifts slowly, shoulders settle.
11 returns near neutral mounted holding, no raised salute.
If rider carries staff, keep it in the same supporting hand throughout; the other hand gestures. A belt wrench stays attached and is not a new weapon. Pony's feet remain planted. No repeated unchanged cutouts, no artificial motion blur.

Not cartoon, anime, glossy modern3D, cute mascot or pixel filter. Full person+pony in every cell, no clipped head/equipment/hooves. At150x175native, gestures must remain understandable.
